description: Rename a file or folder in Google Drive. Changes the name only: content, location, and sharing are untouched. Works on any Drive item the account can edit, including Docs, Sheets, Slides, and folders.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

file_id.description: The Google Drive file or folder ID to rename

name: gws-mcp__drive_rename_file
